core_claim.P: Attacker makes a minimal first deposit (1 wei) into gHYBR, establishing a 1:1 share price, then directly calls IVotingEscrow.deposit_for(veTokenId, amount) to inflate totalAssets() without minting shares
core_claim.I: gHYBR share accounting (shares = depositAmount × totalSupply / totalAssets) must be protected against share price manipulation via direct asset inflation, since totalAssets() reads the veNFT locked amount which anyone can increase
core_claim.V: Subsequent depositors receive 0 shares while losing their entire deposit, and the attacker steals 100% of all subsequent deposits
